mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS caseId, c.title, CASE WHEN c.case_order = 1 THEN TRUE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM game_sessions gs INNER JOIN cases previous_case ON previous_case.id = gs.case_id WHERE gs.player_id = #{playerId} AND gs.status = 'SOLVED' AND previous_case.case_order = c.case_order - 1 ) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS isUnlocked FROM cases c ORDER BY c.case_order
